{{summary | book=6 |
|chapter=28
|title=Letters
|icon=Dagger
|setting=[[Cairhien]] and [[Caemlyn]]
}}

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand worries that [[Lews Therin]] has been silent in his head recently. He resolves to quit running from problems that confront him, like his feelings for [[Aviendha]]. He decides to return to [[Andor]] and receives a letter from the [[Sea Folk]] just before he leaves. When he arrives, Aviendha says he must allow her to go with him when he [[Traveling|Travels]] and gets the [[Far Dareis Mai|Maidens]] guarding him to agree.

[[Reene Harfor]] arrives to announce a number of nobles that have entered Caemlyn, but not come to the palace. Another letter from the Sea Folk is waiting for him. He opens both letters to find that [[Zaida]] is displeased he missed the meeting he scheduled in Caemlyn and [[Harine]] will receive him on her ship in Cairhien. Another letter has arrived and it is delivered by [[Sulin]], wearing a servant's dress. Rand asks her what the servant business is about but she won't answer. The letter is from [[Alliandre]], the Queen of Ghealdan, pledging her support, but not publicly, to avoid [[Aes Sedai]] censure.

A [[Gray Man]] enters the room. Even though Rand saw the door open and close, he didn't noticed the man until he smelled the stench he gives off. Once Rand became aware, he was able to focus on the Gray Man and bind him. As Rand captures him, a bar of fire eliminates the Gray Man, channeled by [[Taim]]. Taim had just arrived by [[Gateway]] to let Rand know a male [[channeling|channeler]], born with the spark in him, has arrived at the Farm.{{ref|This is [[Jahar Narishma]].}} Rand is furious that Taim has not only killed the Gray Man but that he used a Gateway to enter his bedroom. Taim explains he arrived to tell Rand that a man who was born with the spark has arrived at the farm and he killed the Gray Many without thinking. [[Lews Therin]] almost takes control of ''[[saidin]]'' from Rand, in an attempt to kill Taim.

{{pov|[[Padan Fain]]}}

Fain is handling his [[Ruby-hilted dagger|dagger]] from [[Shadar Logoth]], while thinking about Rand. He has a [[Myrddraal]] under his control in the room with him. Somehow he can sense the [[bonding|bond]] Rand has with [[Alanna]], but he doesn't know what it is or what it means. Fain's contamination has brushed [[Pedron Niall]] and [[Elaida]], ensuring that the [[Whitecloaks]] and the [[White Tower|Tower]] Aes Sedai will never trust Rand. Fain set the ambush with the Whitecloaks he commands{{Ref/book|4|26}}, but now he has only a few left. The [[Darkfriend]] Fain is staying with comes into the room with her son. The boy excitedly tells Fain that Rand was attacked that morning by someone the maidens didn't see, but the man was dead. Fain realizes it was a Gray Man and rages against the [[Forsaken]],  knowing it was one of them who sent the creature. Fain turns his anger onto the boy, using his power to harm the child and then he assaults the woman.

==Unanswered Questions==
* Why can Fain sense the bond between Rand and Alanna?
